author: ThioJoe
description:
Who could have seen this coming, besides everyone?

A ton of high profile Instagram accounts got hacked, and it was all because of a STUPID AI that Facebook / Instagram thought would be a good idea to use for support requests. It basically let anyone just ask it to hand over control to any account they wanted. I talk about how it happened, why it was so stupid, and how to protect yourself in the future.
